verdict.rationale: Temporal documents automatic, configurable Activity retries and SDK resilience mechanisms, and a user confirms you can retry units on failure and mark errors as non-retryable, so some code-level error-handling paths exist. Nothing in the pack shows built-in failure notifications, and users report errors buried in the event log with workflows stuck 'In Progress' and no way to run error-level cleanup. missing for 10: documented dedicated error/compensation workflow paths, built-in failure alerting or notifications, independent corroboration that failures surface reliably to ops.
